scripts.buildWasm: pnpm run generateConfig && pnpm run buildSingle && pnpm run buildWithExceptions
scripts.buildSingle: cd build-config; cp ../scripts/fix-destructors.py . && docker run -it --rm -v $(pwd):/src -u $(id -u):$(id -g) --entrypoint sh donalffons/opencascade.js -c 'python3 /src/fix-destructors.py custom_build_single.yml && /opencascade.js/src/buildFromYaml.py custom_build_single.yml' && mv replicad_single* ../src; cd -
scripts.buildWithExceptions: cd build-config; cp ../scripts/fix-destructors.py . && docker run -it --rm -v $(pwd):/src -u $(id -u):$(id -g) --entrypoint sh donalffons/opencascade.js -c 'python3 /src/fix-destructors.py custom_build_with_exceptions.yml && /opencascade.js/src/buildFromYaml.py custom_build_with_exceptions.yml' && mv replicad_with_exceptions* ../src; cd -
